questions.questionText: What does a pandas DataFrame add on top of a raw numpy array?
options: Named columns and an index, making it much easier to work with real, labeled tabular data
DataFrames can only hold text, never numbers
DataFrames remove the need for numpy entirely
questions.correctAnswer: Named columns and an index, making it much easier to work with real, labeled tabular data
questions.explanation: A DataFrame is essentially a 2D array with labels, letting you reference columns by name (df["age"]) instead of remembering numeric positions.

questions.questionText: Why is exploratory data analysis (EDA) recommended before fitting any model?
options: It's an optional step with no real benefit
Checking for missing values, outliers, and feature distributions upfront helps catch data problems (like those in the ML pitfalls lesson) before they silently corrupt results
EDA replaces the need for a train/test split
EDA is only useful for deep learning, not classical ML
questions.correctAnswer: Checking for missing values, outliers, and feature distributions upfront helps catch data problems (like those in the ML pitfalls lesson) before they silently corrupt results
questions.explanation: Skipping EDA is exactly how issues like unexpected nulls or skewed distributions go unnoticed until they've already caused a misleading evaluation.

questions.questionText: What's the standard bridge from a pandas DataFrame to the numpy arrays a model actually trains on?
options: Models can train directly on DataFrames with no conversion needed
Selecting the relevant columns and calling .values or .to_numpy() to get a numpy array
Converting the DataFrame to a Python dictionary first
There is no way to convert a DataFrame to numpy
questions.correctAnswer: Selecting the relevant columns and calling .values or .to_numpy() to get a numpy array
questions.explanation: This is the standard final step connecting data exploration/cleaning in pandas to the numpy-array X inputs used throughout every model in this platform's Classical ML and Deep Learning courses.
